own_solution.law: Static equilibrium with Archimedes' principle: T + m g = rho_liquid V g, so T = (rho_liquid - rho_cube) V g
assumptions: cube fully submerged and at rest

TD98F.regime: string does not break: tension (3.92 N) below the 50 N limit

TD4DC.regime: string does not break: tension (3.92 N) below the 50 N rating

notes: Base: V = 1e-3 m^3; buoyancy 9.8 N, weight 5.88 N, T = 3.92 N. Depth sentences: pressures on top and bottom faces both depend on depth but their difference (buoyancy) does not, so depth cancels (C). Replacement liquid 1250 kg/m^3: T = 650*1e-3*9.8 = 6.37 N. Variant pairs state the same number and unit (50 cm, 1250 kg/m^3, 50 N). Minor: T8DA9 says 'holds the cube under this new liquid' without 'completely', while T1230 says 'completely under its surface'; read naturally both mean fully submerged. Both replacement sentences make the asked tension refer to the new configuration; acceptable.
